name: Crown tile, front left
note: One of four crown tiles. Together they hold the 15.6 inch screen face-down above the glass, the camera, two mic holes and the exhaust grille.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

note: One of four crown tiles. Together they hold the 15.6 inch screen face-down above the glass, the camera, two mic holes and the exhaust grille.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

note: One of four crown tiles. Together they hold the 15.6 inch screen face-down above the glass, the camera, two mic holes and the exhaust grille.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

note: One of four crown tiles. Together they hold the 15.6 inch screen face-down above the glass, the camera, two mic holes and the exhaust grille.
print: Print upside down (top on the bed).

name: Screen clips (set of 4)
note: Hold the screen down on its ledge.
print: Print flat, all four at once.

name: Camera bracket
note: Holds a small USB camera behind the front window. It tells the turntable where you are, so she always turns to face you.

name: Light bar diffusers (2 halves)
note: A glowing strip across the front of the base, printed in two halves.

name: Speaker baffle
note: Holds a 3 inch full-range speaker behind the front grille.

name: Electronics trays (pair)
note: Mount the ESP32, amplifier, USB hub and power board in the back of the base.

name: Turntable top plate with ring gear (4 quarters)
note: Screws to the bottom of the capsule and to the top race of the bearing. The ring of teeth inside it is what the motor turns.

name: Motor pinion
note: Press-fits on the motor shaft and drives the ring gear about six to one, slow and quiet.

name: Turntable plinth (4 quarters)
note: The fixed round base. It carries the bearing and the motor, with a glowing ring round its waist. The capsule turns above it.
print: Print upside down (deck on the bed). No supports.

name: Plinth floor (4 quarters)
note: Closes the plinth. Three rubber feet sit in its recesses; vents under the motor driver.

name: 15.6 inch portable monitor, face down (about 357 x 223 x 10 mm)
note: Any slim 15.6 inch portable monitor (USB-C or mini HDMI), as bright as possible. Its long side runs front to back, which sets her height.

name: Beam-splitter glass, about 226 x 491 mm
note: Teleprompter glass (about 70/30) at 45 degrees. 3 mm, one sheet.

name: Smoked acrylic side panel left
note: Dark tinted 3 mm acrylic, 452 x 360 mm.

name: Smoked acrylic side panel right
note: Dark tinted 3 mm acrylic, 452 x 360 mm.

name: Matte black back panel
note: Black foam board or acrylic.

name: 3 inch speaker + amplifier
note: Behind the front grille.

name: USB camera board
note: Small 1080p camera.

name: Where her image appears (about 31 cm)
note: A flat stand-in shape marking where her reflected image stands. Her real model never goes into these files.

name: 300 mm round turntable bearing
note: A steel ball-bearing "lazy Susan" ring, about 300 mm across and 10 mm thick. Takes the capsule weight.

name: Pancake stepper motor (NEMA 17, 23 mm)
note: Hangs under the plinth deck. Driven by a silent TMC2209 driver, so you will not hear it turn.

name: Motor driver + ESP32 board
note: Silent stepper driver and controller, plus a hall sensor that finds the home position.
